LanguageData.LP_ChainLash.label: chain pull
LanguageData.LP_ChainLash.description: Fling a chain: one target within 4 cells takes a chain hit (blunt 14) and is yanked to its side. Cooldown 10 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_HellfireHurl.label: hellfire
LanguageData.LP_HellfireHurl.description: Hurl a ball of hellfire at a target within 10 cells: fire 15, may ignite. Cooldown 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_HuntersMark.label: hunt
LanguageData.LP_HuntersMark.description: Mark an enemy for 3 days: the erinyes deals +15% damage to it. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesEntangle.label: binding rope
LanguageData.LP_ErinyesEntangle.description: Throw a golden rope: one target within 8 cells makes a Dexterity save (difficulty rises with the erinyes's proficiency bonus and Dexterity; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or is bound for 4 seconds. Cooldown 2 hours.
LanguageData.LP_RopeEntangle.label: binding rope
LanguageData.LP_RopeEntangle.description: Throw the binding rope: one target within 8 cells makes a Dexterity save (difficulty rises with the user's proficiency bonus and Dexterity; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or is bound for 4 seconds. Uses 1 point of the rope's durability. Cooldown 2 hours.
LanguageData.LP_SatyrCharge.label: ram
LanguageData.LP_SatyrCharge.description: Lower your head and charge next to a target within 6 cells: the target makes a Strength save (difficulty rises with the satyr's proficiency bonus and Strength; each point of the target's ability modifier and proficiency bonus gives +5% success) or falls for 1 second. Cooldown 4 hours.
LanguageData.LP_TreeStride.label: tree stride
LanguageData.LP_TreeStride.description: Walk into a nearby tree and come out next to another adult tree within 30 cells. Cooldown 2 hours.
LanguageData.LP_BindTree.label: bind to this tree
LanguageData.LP_BindTree.description: Bind yourself to an adult tree nearby (growth ≥80%, not in a growing zone, not claimed by another dryad). Cooldown 1 hour.
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingFaces.label: thousand faces
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingFaces.description: Copy the appearance and name of a visible humanlike within 12 cells for 24 hours; ends early when seen by a devil's eye or a deva's truesight. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_DevaHealingTouch.label: healing touch
LanguageData.LP_DevaHealingTouch.description: Lay a hand on the wound: heals a person's worst wound. Cooldown 8 hours (3 per day).
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarWrath.label: celestial wrath
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarWrath.description: Raise the sword to the heavens: enemies within 8 cells take 30 radiant damage. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarBanish.label: dispel
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarBanish.description: Command an outsider (demon, devil, fey) to leave: it makes a Charisma save (difficulty 20, base success 15%) or is driven back to its own plane; legendary bosses spend one legendary resistance first. Cooldown 1 hour.
